//ConnectionStrings: The Landlord app runs against its OWN database. Put the real connection string in appsettings.Local.json (gitignored) or env var ConnectionStrings__LeasingConnection. DefaultConnection is only a fallback / design-time value.
//Seed: On a fresh database the app creates this Business Unit and a break-glass administrator (LeasingDbSeeder). Change the password immediately after first sign-in.
//Ocr: Emirates ID OCR auto-read. Leave Provider blank to disable (text PDFs still parse locally).
//BlobStorage: Enabled=false stores uploaded documents in the database. Set a ConnectionString + Enabled=true to store new uploads in Azure Blob.
//Email: Precedence: Microsoft Graph (fill all four under Graph) > SQL Server Database Mail (Leasing:MailProfile). Supply Graph:ClientSecret via env var / Local file, never commit it.
//ApiSecurity: Self-service OAuth API (/connect/token + /api/selfservice/landlord/*) consumed by the Landlord DMZ app. A BLANK SigningKey leaves the API UNMAPPED (internal portal only). To enable the DMZ app, set SigningKey and a Clients[0] whose ClientSecret matches the DMZ app's Api:ClientSecret. Keep real values in appsettings.Local.json.
//Leasing: Landlord module settings. Zones filter the property list. UaePass + Circularo (e-signature) are disabled by default; fill and enable per environment. Secrets belong in appsettings.Local.json.

Circularo.RequestMessage: Please review and sign your landlord registration document for Dubai Investments.
